title: Bangladesh Public Database Dataset Metadata
description: Standard metadata schema for every dataset in the Bangladesh Biggest Public Database repository.

dataset_name.description: Descriptive, human-readable title of the dataset.

category.description: Primary subject category of the dataset.

description.description: Comprehensive summary of contents, scope, collection method, and notes.

source.description: Official organization, agency, ministry, or institution providing the data.

source_url.description: Official URL or portal where the source data or reference publication is hosted.

license.description: Verified license (e.g., Open Government Data, CC-BY-4.0, MIT, Public Domain, or Source Reference).

last_updated.description: Date of latest data verification or update in YYYY-MM-DD format.

record_count.description: Exact number of records or observations contained in the dataset.

format.description: File formats available for this dataset.

language.description: Languages present in the data headers or values.

verification_status.description: Verification state based on official primary source cross-referencing.

citation.description: Formal citation or reference string for academic and research publications.
